policies.description: Daily individual meal cap for business travel is $75.00 total. Alcohol without client presence is strictly non-reimbursable.
Domestic airline flights must be booked in Economy/Coach class. Business class is prohibited unless flight duration exceeds 8 continuous hours.
Hotel lodging cap is $250.00/night for standard cities, $350.00/night for designated high-cost tiers (NYC, SF, London, Tokyo).
Rideshare (Uber, Lyft) and taxi expenses permitted between airport, hotel, and client site. Maximum $100.00 per single trip.
Standard home office peripherals and stationery reimbursed up to $200.00 per submission. Monitors and computers require IT procurement approval.
Monthly developer tools, SaaS subscriptions, or cloud sandboxes up to $150.00 require manager approval.
